title: [Bug] LobeHub database version's ollama provider sends request to lobe's host instead of localhost by default
body: ### 📦 部署环境 Docker ### 📌 软件版本 v1.47.21 ### 💻 系统环境 macOS ### 🌐 浏览器 Chrome ### 🐛 问题描述 LobeHub database version's ollama provider sends requests to lobe's host instead of localhost by default. Checking passed, but it gets a `TypeError`. I have to manually assign `http://127.0.0.1:11434` to `Interface proxy address` to make it work. I think the standalone version, which does not have database attached, works fine, and it show friendly guidance to help user setup Ollama server. ### 📷 复现步骤 1. enable ollama provider. 2. send request to ollama hosted model. ### 🚦 期望结果 1. send request to `http://127.0.0.1:11434` by default. 2. allow browser requesting. ### 📝 补充信息 _No response_
